method: 24 s of stepped runtime per world (4 areas x 6 x api.step(1)), actors released. api.step is used rather than real time because the Browser pane pauses requestAnimationFrame when hidden, which made every vehicle read as stuck in Stage 2A.2.
notes: offRoad counts samples further than halfRoad + 1.5 m from every road centreline.
onCarriageway uses d <= halfRoad, a crude proxy; the candidate's 26 of 184 (14.1%) against the control's 15 of 141 (10.6%) is not an improvement and is not claimed as one.
Spawn and core-spec counts agree exactly with the headless build, which is the cross-check that the runtime is the same world the measurements describe.
